classifier_training_input: rank-1 candidate feature vectors from TRAIN stars
classifier_training_labels: train_pack/train_labels.csv label joined by numeric KIC ID
classifier_oof_score: dependency-free logistic model predictions from 5 star-level folds
threshold_optimization_space: TRAIN OOF statistical baseline or ML score, whichever has higher OOF F1
reported_confidence_space: OOF isotonic calibration of selected decision score
selection_reason: statistical baseline OOF F1 0.410 and AP 0.266 exceeded dependency-free ML OOF F1 0.399 and AP 0.217
conclusion: ML is integrated and evaluated, but does not improve the statistical baseline and is not selected
